checks.name: full_image_matches_in_same_or_flipped_raw_row_order
checks.orientationDescription: GPU row0 matches WebGL readPixels rowH-1 (top row)

copy.source: actual native WebGL default RGBA16F drawing buffer
copy.destination: same actual WebGPU presentation texture after external copy
limits: One explicit full-frame readPixels and COPY_SRC readback can stall this frame. Exclude it from performance statistics.
Comparison tests the actual source/destination values and raw row orientation, not panel luminance or physical scene/source calibration.
One-OETF/peak/white references explain measured encoded statistics; equal copied values alone cannot prove an upstream OETF was applied exactly once.
Uniform/symmetric frames can match both row orders; orientation is then explicitly ambiguous without failing otherwise valid colour copying.

comparison.orientationDescription: GPU row0 matches WebGL readPixels rowH-1 (top row)

reference.interpretation: Decoded values assume one sRGB OETF and the supplied OS/browser white. They are a unit-consistency reference, not source/scene/panel photometric calibration and not proof of OETF count.
